entities.name: Liberal Era and Political Instability
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Liberal Party overthrew Colorado rule in 1904 and governed until 1936, but the period was marked by extreme political instability (over 20 presidents in 28 years), economic stagnation, foreign corporate dominance of land and industry, and growing territorial tension with Bolivia over the Chaco.
